checks.notes: Double precision signed solid angle sum over all other original closed outward solids. Inside contributions add, rather than odd/even cancelling overlaps. Combined with zero candidate/rest triangle crossings, this distinguishes disjoint pieces from wholly contained pieces. 1e-8 is dimensionless floating summation diagnostic, not anatomical gap threshold.
